scripts.preinstall: bun -e "if (!(process.env.npm_config_user_agent || '').includes('bun')) { console.error('This project requires Bun (https://bun.sh). Use: bun install'); process.exit(1); }"
scripts.docker:run: bun run docker:build && docker run --rm -it --init --gpus all --device /dev/dri:/dev/dri --shm-size=2g --add-host=host.docker.internal:host-gateway -e CONFIG_PATH=/app/config.json -v "${PWD}/config.json:/app/config.json:ro" browser_source
